swap_submitted.meaning: user has submitted a swap transaction to the Router contract
swap_submitted.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

deadline_specifiable.meaning: Router/Core allow the user to specify a deadline for the swap transaction
deadline_specifiable.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

slippage_protection_present.meaning: Router provides slippage protection via calculatedAmountThreshold and sqrtRatioLimit relative to execution time
slippage_protection_present.checkpoint: before execution of the submitted swap

executed_after_deadline.meaning: the swap transaction is executed after the user-specified deadline (significant delay)
executed_after_deadline.checkpoint: at execution of the submitted swap

loss_of_opportunity_occurred.meaning: user suffers loss of opportunity from the delayed execution, particularly during high network congestion or volatility
loss_of_opportunity_occurred.checkpoint: after execution of the submitted swap

assumptions: The swap transaction is submitted without a user-specified deadline because the contracts do not accept one.
Slippage protection (calculatedAmountThreshold, sqrtRatioLimit) is the only time-related protection available to the user.

unresolved.description: Report describes the delay scenario conditionally; it does not state that a specific transaction was actually held and executed late, nor any concrete delay duration.
No concrete amounts, values, or specific unfavorable market-condition changes are given for the loss of opportunity.

limitations: Loss of opportunity is encoded as a report-grounded Boolean outcome; no numeric magnitude is supplied by the report.
The deadline is user-specified in the intent but the report states the contracts do not allow specifying one, so the condition binds deadline_specifiable=false as the reported scenario.
Execution-after-deadline and loss-of-opportunity observables are bound at execution/after-execution checkpoints and are not part of P.
